rationales: Milk of magnesia is a suspension of magnesium hydroxide in water.
Sugar dissolves to form a homogeneous solution.
Ink is generally treated as a colloid, not a suspension.
Milk is a colloid (emulsion), not a suspension.
9.8 amu is far too small for the molar mass of H₂SO₄.
98 amu is the molecular mass in atomic mass units, not the molar mass in grams.
The molar mass is approximately 98 g/mol; this option gives the intended value in grams.
9.8 g is one tenth of the molar mass.
Aluminum is the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Gold is much less abundant than aluminum.
Silver is not the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Platinum is rare and is not the most abundant metal.
J. J. Thomson discovered the electron, not the proton.
Goldstein discovered canal rays, not the proton.
Rutherford is credited with discovering the proton.
Niels Bohr developed a model of the atom, not the proton’s discovery.
Sulfuric acid solution ionizes in water and conducts electricity.
Sugar solution does not form ions, so it is a non-electrolyte.
Lime solution contains ions and can conduct electricity.
Sodium chloride solution contains ions and conducts electricity.
Mist consists of tiny liquid droplets dispersed in a gas.
Gas in liquid describes a different type of mixture, such as foam.
Solid in gas describes an aerosol such as smoke.
Gas in solid is not the composition of mist.
The K shell has one subshell.
The L shell has two subshells.
The M shell has three subshells.
The N shell has four subshells.
Mendeleev did not arrange elements by electronic configuration.
Mendeleev arranged elements mainly in order of increasing atomic mass.
Atomic number was the basis of the modern periodic table, not Mendeleev’s table.
Completion of a subshell is not the basis of Mendeleev’s table.
The first period contains hydrogen and helium, so it has two elements.
The first period does not contain three elements.
The first period does not contain four elements.
Six elements occur in the second period, not the first.
O₂ and Cl₂ have nonpolar covalent bonds between identical atoms.
H₂O has polar covalent bonds, but N₂ has a nonpolar bond.
H₂O has polar covalent bonds, while C₂H₂ is generally treated as a nonpolar molecule.
Both H₂O and HCl contain polar covalent bonds.
Benzene is not the solvent in ordinary soft drinks.
Water is the main solvent in soft drinks.
Milk is not the solvent in ordinary soft drinks.
Oil is not the solvent in ordinary soft drinks.
Graphite is soft and slippery, not extremely hard.
Phosphorus is not extremely hard.
Iodine is a brittle molecular solid, not extremely hard.
Diamond is an extremely hard form of carbon.
Calcium is not typically described as soft enough to be cut with a knife.
Sodium is a soft metal that can be cut with a knife.
Magnesium is harder than sodium and is not readily cut with a knife.
Iron is a hard metal and cannot be cut with a knife.
Mercury is liquid at room temperature, not gaseous.
Gold is a solid at room temperature.
Oxygen is a gas at room temperature.
Sodium is a solid at room temperature.
1.08 g is not hydrogen’s gram atomic mass.
1.008 amu is the atomic mass, not the gram atomic mass.
2.016 g corresponds to the gram molecular mass of H₂, not the gram atomic mass of H.
The gram atomic mass of hydrogen is 1.008 g.
